jobs.description:
Why this role
Want to build and improve an industrial process, hands-on? At Supernormal Greens, we’re building the journey from harvested plants to finished botanical ingredients. Now we’re looking for an engineer who wants to understand that process inside out and make it work better.
Our post-harvest process covers washing, cryogenic freezing, frozen storage, freeze-drying, milling and packing. You’ll join while we’re developing and commissioning it, with plenty to test, understand and improve.
Your job is easy to describe: help the process deliver more, with the right quality and a stable operation. You’ll work closely with production, maintenance, quality and R&D, and have a real say in the equipment and ways of working.

What you will do
Get to know the process. Understand how each step works, where we lose capacity or yield, and what could run better. 

Test your ideas. Plan trials, use the data and check which changes actually improve performance. 

Work close to the equipment. Team up with operators and technicians to solve problems and find their root causes. 

Help bring new equipment into production. Work with suppliers on requirements, factory and site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT), installation and commissioning. 

Make improvements last. Put instructions, documentation and maintenance requirements in place as equipment moves into stable production. 

Share what you learn. Develop standard ways of working, support operator training and work with maintenance on preventive and operator maintenance.

Post-harvest is your main focus. You’ll also work with our Cultivation Technology Specialist and occasionally help with other technical projects.
Priorities are agreed with your manager.

What you will bring (must-haves)
A relevant engineering degree or equivalent competence gained through experience. 

A few years of technical experience close to industrial production, with examples of problems solved or improvements delivered. 

The ability to use data and trials to investigate problems and evaluate results. 

A structured, practical approach and the ability to move work forward together with colleagues. 

Good spoken and written English for supplier and team collaboration and technical documentation. Swedish is an advantage.

Bonus (nice-to-haves)
Experience with freezing, freeze-drying, milling or packing, preferably in food or process manufacturing. 

Involvement in equipment installation, commissioning or production ramp-up. 

Experience working with suppliers, root cause analysis, standard work or maintenance development.

Your growth guide
Meet Gustav Edberg, our Chief Production Officer and your manager. Gustav is down-to-earth, listens carefully and cares about the people he works with. He also expects you to take ownership and follow through. Manufacturing excellence is very much his thing.
He joined us in November 2025, bringing experience in process improvement and factory development from Tetra Pak and across industries by consulting at EFESO Nordics. Together, you’ll agree priorities and follow up on progress.
Some other facts
Full time in Tibro, Sweden, normally 07:00–16:00. Primarily on site, with some remote flexibility when tasks allow. Some supplier travel and busier periods during commissioning may occur.
Permanent employment with an initial probationary period. We have a collective bargaining agreement through Livsmedelsföretagen, including occupational pension and insurance under the applicable terms, plus an annual wellness allowance of SEK 3,000.
We interview as applications come in and aim to fill the role as soon as possible, with a start date agreed together. If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we’d like to hear from you.
About Supernormal Greens
We are everything but normal. Research and industrial production work side by side in our 7,000 m² vertical farming facility. By controlling the cultivation environment, we develop plants and botanical ingredients for applications including cosmetics and nutraceuticals. You will work with new process technology and follow your solutions from trials into production.

jobs.description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!
Are you an experienced specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology looking for a role where you can combine advanced clinical work, collaboration with highly skilled colleagues, and excellent opportunities for professional development?
We are currently seeking a hepatologist with at least five years of experience as a specialist physician to join a highly specialized team at one of Sweden’s leading university-affiliated hospitals. This opportunity offers the chance to work with complex liver disease, transplantation medicine, and tertiary-level care in a modern and research-oriented environment.
About the department
The department is one of the largest and most specialized units within gastroenterology and hepatology in the Nordic region. It provides both emergency and elective care and works closely with several highly specialized disciplines.
You will become part of an international team of approximately ten specialist physicians with diverse professional backgrounds and areas of expertise. Collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to the department's culture.
The unit manages a broad spectrum of hepatology cases, including advanced liver disease and liver transplantation, while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, education, and research.
Your role
As a specialist in gastroenterology and hepatology, you will:
Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with complex liver diseases
Participate in both outpatient and inpatient hepatology care
Work closely with multidisciplinary teams involved in advanced liver treatment and transplantation
Contribute to teaching and supervision of junior colleagues and medical students
Participate in quality improvement initiatives and departmental development
Take part in on-call duties together with experienced colleagues

Qualifications
We are looking for a candidate who has:
EU-recognized specialist certification in Gastroenterology and Hepatology
At least five years of experience working as a specialist physician
Experience in hepatology and management of advanced liver diseases
Experience related to liver transplantation
Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish
The ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment

Research experience, academic involvement, or a PhD is considered an advantage.
Why work here?
This opportunity combines highly specialized medicine with an excellent quality of life.
The region offers:
Easy access to coastlines, nature, and outdoor activities
A vibrant cultural scene and excellent public services
International connections and modern infrastructure
A safe and family-friendly environment
Excellent opportunities for long-term professional development

You will work in a progressive healthcare setting where innovation, education, research, and high-quality patient care are closely integrated.
What Dignus Medical offers you:
Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals
Help with relocation, accommodation, and support for your family if needed
Access to a free language course with a private tutor via Teams/Skype

Take the next step in your career
This is an excellent opportunity for experienced hepatologists with liver transplantation experience who want to work in a highly specialized and progressive environment while enjoying a high quality of life.
Don’t hesitate to contact me. I look forward to hearing from you and helping you find the perfect job that matches your experience and ambitions.
 
Application
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the final application date.
Submit your application today and include:
CV / résumé
Diploma and educational certificates/ Proof of professional license/registration
Motivation letter
References from at least one manager and one professional colleague

We look forward to receiving your application!
You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

About Univrses
Univrses is a Stockholm-based 3D Computer Vision and AI company. We provide the perception and spatial awareness necessary for an increasingly autonomous world. While our roots are in the automotive sector, we have pioneered a new category: Infrastructure Intelligence. Our 3DAI™ system transforms ordinary vehicles into sophisticated mobile sensors, providing road authorities across Europe (Sweden, UK, Italy, and beyond) with real-time, actionable insights. We are shifting city management from reactive repairs to proactive, data-driven maintenance—saving costs, reducing CO2 emissions, and improving public safety.
The Role
As a Senior Sysadmin at Univrses, you will be the backbone of our technical operations, ensuring that our entire engineering organization has the stable, secure, and scalable infrastructure it needs to thrive.
In this role, you will work closely with the CTO to design and maintain a company-wide infrastructure that is both resilient and secure. You will oversee the cross-functional systems that support all our research, development, and production environments. We are looking for a proactive professional to manage our cloud footprint and on-premise resources, ensuring our team of world-class engineers can work without friction.
This is a on-site position since you will be responsible of our on premise infrastructure.
Responsibilities
Strategic Infrastructure Support: implement long-term infrastructure roadmaps that prioritize company-wide stability and data security.

Core Systems Oversight: Design, deploy, and maintain robust server environments (both AWS and on-premise) that support multiple project teams.

System Reliability & Uptime: Proactively monitor system health and performance across the organization to ensure high availability for all internal and external services.

Resource Governance: Manage global resource allocation (databases, storage, compute).

Security & Access Control: Implement and enforce company-wide security.

Disaster Recovery: Develop and maintain rigorous backup strategies and recovery procedures to protect company data and intellectual property.

Who you are
Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Experience: 5+ years of experience in Systems Administration, Infrastructure Engineering, or SRE.

Maintenance Pro: Proven track record in patch management, software distribution, and maintaining system integrity across a fleet of machines.

Linux Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux/Unix administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).

Networking Specialist: Strong understanding of networking architecture.

Cloud & Containers: Proven experience managing AWS environments and containerized applications using Docker.

Reliability Mindset: A "security-first" and "stability-first" approach to managing infrastructure, with the communication skills to report directly to technical leadership.

Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation.

Monitoring Stacks: Experience setting up company-wide monitoring using Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK.

Storage Solutions: Experience managing large-scale data storage (S3, NAS, Artifactory).

What’s in it for You?
We provide the environment and the tools for you to do the best work of your career.

Responsibility: Become a true stakeholder in a small team where your work actually matters.

Professional Evolution: You will be working on exciting projects involving game-changing technology with an opportunity to improve the world through autonomy and intelligence

The "Work-Life" Blend: Enjoy flexible work hours and a culture that values output over "desk time".

Upsides: A secure Pension Plan and Wellness activities for up to 5 000 SEK per year paid by the company.

The Univrses Culture:

Monday Momentum: Kick off the week with team breakfast.

Thursday Knowledge: Weekly Lunch & Learns where internal or external speakers present interesting topics, while the company pays for and caters the lunch to keep your technical and commercial skills sharp.

Friday Wind-down: Celebrate the week’s wins with our Friday After Work sessions (free beer from our well-curated beer fridge!)

The Workspace: A bright, collaborative office in Stockholm equipped with the essentials (yes, including the mandatory startup ping-pong table).

Next Steps
If you are a systems-oriented thinker who enjoys building stable environments and working at a strategic level to support a high-performing engineering culture, please submit your resume and a cover letter in English!

About Comsys
Comsys AB is a Swedish cleantech company based in Lund, developing advanced solutions for power quality and energy efficiency. Our products help industries and critical infrastructure use electricity more reliably and efficiently, addressing complex challenges such as harmonics, resonance, flicker and load imbalance.
At the heart of our technology is our patented Active Dynamic Filtering (ADF) technology. With more than 20 years of experience and customers in over 50 countries, Comsys is continuously pushing the boundaries of power electronics and developing high-performance solutions for demanding industrial applications.
At Comsys, engineering is at the core of what we do. You will work in a highly cross-functional environment, collaborating across disciplines such as software, electronics, FPGA and systems engineering to turn complex technology into robust, high-performance products.
https://comsys.se
Do you enjoy writing software that interacts closely with hardware – and seeing your code become part of real, high-performance products?
We are looking for an Embedded Software Engineer to join our R&D team in Lund. This is an opportunity to work hands-on with embedded C/C++, Embedded Linux, RTOS, networking and low-level software, in close collaboration with experienced hardware, FPGA and system engineers.
You will be part of the development of advanced industrial products where reliability, performance and robust software matter.
The Role
As an Embedded Software Engineer, you will contribute throughout the product development lifecycle – from software architecture and low-level implementation to integration, verification and release.
You will work close to the hardware and collaborate daily with software, hardware, FPGA and system engineers. The role offers a mix of hands-on development, problem solving, debugging and system-level thinking.

Your responsibilities will include:

Develop low-level software and embedded system components

Work with Embedded Linux and RTOS in resource-constrained and performance-critical systems

Develop and integrate networking functionality in embedded systems

Build, customize and maintain embedded Linux

Collaborate closely with hardware, FPGA and system engineers during development and integration

Debug complex software/hardware issues and troubleshoot at system level

Contribute to automated testing, development tools and continuous improvement of software processes

About You
We are looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding how things work all the way down to the system level. You are comfortable working close to hardware and are motivated by solving complex technical problems. At the same time, you are passionate about agile development and helping the team become better, and enjoy combining technical depth with an interest in Scrum, methodology and team development.
You likely have:

A degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience

Professional experience in embedded software development

Strong programming skills in C and C++

Experience with Embedded Linux and/or RTOS

Experience with low-level programming, embedded networking and debugging

Experience developing secure embedded software and applying cybersecurity requirements in accordance with IEC 62443

A structured, analytical and solution-oriented approach to problem solving

Good communication skills in English

It's a Plus If You Have

Experience with Rust in embedded or systems programming

FPGA development experience

Experience developing automated tests or automated test systems

Experience with CI/CD, continuous integration or software quality processes

Experience working with industrial, power electronics, control systems or other hardware-near applications

Why Join Us?
At Comsys, you won't be developing software in isolation. You will work at the intersection of software, electronics, FPGA and system engineering, contributing to products that solve real industrial challenges.
You will have the opportunity to take ownership, work across the technology stack and develop your expertise in embedded systems, Linux, real-time software and hardware integration.
If you are an Embedded Software Engineer who enjoys C/C++, Linux, RTOS, low-level development and working close to hardware, we'd like to hear from you.
In this recruitment process, we are partnering with Radeptus. For any questions regarding the position, please contact Jenny Månsson at +46 703 318 506 or via email at jenny@adeptus.se. Please submit your application here (link).

We are looking for an experienced Site Quality Manager for a construction and installation project.
This is a consulting assignment. The location is Kiruna, Sweden.
The position is full-time.
The assignment involves close collaboration with the client, requiring a high degree of flexibility and strong collaboration skills.
The Assignment
As Site Quality Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and following up quality management activities at site. The role includes ensuring that quality processes, inspections, documentation, and corrective actions are carried out in accordance with the contract and agreed project procedures.
Your responsibilities will include:

Establishing and maintaining project-specific Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for site activities and ensuring compliance with contractual requirements.

Following up the quality inspection process and ensuring that responsible supervisors and installation teams perform their own inspections and basic inspections according to agreed plans and procedures.

Coordinating third-party inspections, including NDT inspections, and ensuring appropriate actions are taken when deviations are identified.

Coordinating and arranging inspections together with the client, including witness points and hold points as specified in the contract.

Participating in weekly and site meetings and reporting on quality management progress across the different site areas.

Using Dalux for documentation management and quality tracking.

Organising and following up activities according to the project's daily management model.

Identifying and managing deviations and Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

Performing root cause analysis and implementing actions to minimise the risk of recurring non-conformities.

Preparing and delivering quality documentation and reports to the client as agreed.

Ensuring that subcontractors understand and comply with the project's quality management requirements.

Introducing and reviewing scope-specific ITPs together with responsible supervisors, foremen, and subcontractors.

Managing the handover documentation process and ensuring that required documentation is collected and submitted to the client correctly and on time.

Collaborating with the Project Manager and the wider project team regarding quality and risk management.

Coaching and supporting site management, installation teams, and subcontractors in quality-related matters.

Organising site meetings and reporting on quality activities and progress.

Requirements
We are looking for a candidate with relevant education and professional experience suitable for the role.
You should have relevant experience in areas such as:

Quality management and quality follow-up in construction and/or installation projects.

Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs).

Quality inspections and inspection processes.

Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and deviation management.

Root cause analysis.

Third-party inspections and NDT inspections.

Witness points and hold points.

Quality management and follow-up of subcontractors.

Handover documentation and document management.

Quality and risk management.

Digital quality and documentation management systems, preferably Dalux.

Very good command of English, both spoken and written.

You are structured, quality-focused, and communicative, with the ability to coordinate quality activities between several stakeholders. You are comfortable working closely with project management, site teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and the client.
If this assignment sounds interesting and matches your experience, we look forward to receiving your application and CV.

Job Title: Platform Engineer
Reports to: Engineering Manager
Department: Engineering
Location: Gothenburg, Remote in Sweden

Avinode is looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Cloud Platform Engineering team on a permanent basis. Over the past year we’ve been on a modernisation streak, reducing our maintenance load to be able to grow the team’s responsibilities and the kind of projects we can sustainably undertake. We’ve recently fully rebuilt our PCI enviornment, and are now undertaking a project to finalise our transition to exclusively running containerised services.
The team you’ll join consists of 4 DevOps/Site Reliability/Platform Engineers, supported by an Engineering Manager with a background in Site Reliability Engineering. We operate a cloud-only environment and are responsible for its operation, availability, observability and security. Most of our systems are Linux-based and run Java applications. But for this position we’re looking for someone with experience supporting a .NET/C# and Windows application stack, or being an experienced .NET/C# developer with an affinity for platform engineering and cloud infrastructure.
What you’ll do
You’ll support the team as we work through adopting, modernising and rebuilding this part of our cloud environment. This will involve:
· Ensuring the Windows environment remains in good shape, through practices like automated security patching, configuration management and good integration with our observability stack.
· Improving and simplifing our Continuous Integration systems and pipelines.
· Contributing to the applications to improve how they leverage current Azure services, or adopt new Azure services, to reduce the maintenance cost.
· Harmonising how we operate and maintain our Windows and Linux environments, adopting the same toolset and practices across both where feasible.
· Supporting the work to run these applications on a Linux-backed containerised stack.
· Contributing to the team’s roadmap, which will involve work related to security, observability and improving the developer experience.

Who you are
· You are a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer with 3+ years of experience supporting a .NET/C# and Windows stack for SaaS services. Or,
· You are a .NET/C# developer with 3+ years of experience, with an affinity for cloud infrastructure and at least a year of experience running and operating Windows systems to host SaaS services.
· You have worked with infrastructure in cloud environments before. We use Azure, but experience with AWS or GCP is welcome too.
· You’re familiar with tools like terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Azure Machine Configuration (or equivalent) etc.
· You have some familiarity with Linux systems and running containers.
· You have an interest in the security of our systems and infrastructure.
· You have a product mindset, seeing the infrastructure and our tooling as services we offer to other teams.
· You are self-driven and can figure things out on your own with some support from others.

What do we offer you?
We are proud to offer you a workplace where we have high engagement and where creativity and curiosity is always much appreciated. Your ideas will be heard.
· Ability to schedule your calendar with flexible work locations.
· Competitive salary and benefits
· Synergy events where all Noders across meet each other to collaborate on a professional level as well as having fun which is equally as important.
· Great opportunities to develop certain skill or to learn new things with trainings. We want to support your development and dreams.

Want to join our crew?

Working closely with the Product Manager, you will contribute to the vision and roadmap for our IAM portfolio, own the backlog and guide delivery across Product, Engineering, Architecture and Security.

About Clavister Clavister is a European cybersecurity company founded in 1997 and headquartered in Örnsköldsvik. We develop solutions across network security, identity and access management, cloud security, machine learning and AI for customers in the public sector, critical infrastructure, defence and telecommunications. With our partners and distributors, our hardware and software are deployed in more than 100 countries.

The role This role combines product ownership, people leadership and engineering delivery. Creating focus, developing people and building an effective team are more important than being an IAM specialist.

Drive delivery from refinement and planning through development, automated testing and operational follow-up.

Recruit, coach and mentor team members and foster trust, learning and knowledge sharing.

The team has clear priorities and ownership, delivers secure and maintainable products with predictable quality and flow, and grows through collaborative decision-making and a healthy engineering culture.

To thrive in this role we believe you have

Experience leading and developing commercial software product teams, with focus on people, performance, collaboration and delivery.

Senior Project Engineer – Control & Protection Software, Se-quence & Interlocking HVDC
The opportunity
Our names are Andrew Carruthers and Richard Palm, and together we lead the teams responsible for Sequence & Interlocking within HVDC Control & Protection. Our work sits at the operational core of an HVDC station.
We define the logic that ensures equipment is operated safely and correctly. We develop interlocking principles, automated switching sequences, operating states, and the conditions that determine when a station is ready to perform a specific action. Our solutions help ensure that complex HVDC systems operate safely, predictably, and reliably throughout their lifecycle.
As HVDC technology continues to evolve, so do the challenges. New technologies, new customer requirements, and new ways of operating power systems continuously shape how we work. Success depends on our team members who can understand the bigger picture, exercise strong engineering judgement, and transform complex requirements into robust and reliable solutions.
We are looking for experienced engineers who enjoy technical ownership, system thinking, and solving challenging engineering problems together with highly skilled colleagues.
This is not a role for someone looking to simply execute predefined tasks. It is a role for you who want to understand how things work, influence technical decisions, and contribute to the future of HVDC technology.
“As managers, our goal is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work while continuing to develop their skills and expertise. We strongly believe in open technical discussions, knowledge sharing, mentoring, and a psychologically safe environment where questions, feedback, and continuous learning are encouraged. We value every person's voice and believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger.” Andrew Carruthers & Richard Palm, Hiring Managers
How you'll make an impact
Design and develop Sequence & Interlocking solutions for HVDC Control & Protection systems.
Transform system and customer requirements into robust operational logic and engineering solutions.
Work closely with system design, control, protection, testing, and commissioning teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Take technical ownership of specific functions, systems, or project areas.
Verify and validate solutions through testing, troubleshooting, and system integration activities.
Support commissioning activities and experience how your engineering decisions perform in the real world.
Drive technical discussions both internally and with customers.
Mentor and support less experienced engineers while contributing to the development of our team's technical capability.
Contribute to future methods, tools, and technical solutions within Sequence & Interlocking.

Your background
We care more about technical capability and your personal skills than matching every item on a checklist. You likely have:
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Control Systems, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
Several years of experience working with complex technical systems.
Experience in HVDC, FACTS, substation automation, protection and control systems, industrial automation, power systems, or similar fields.
Experience with commissioning, protection systems, relay applications, operational sequencing, or HVDC projects is highly valued.
Strong analytical skills and an ability to understand interactions across multiple systems and disciplines.
The confidence to challenge assumptions and contribute to technical discussions.
A structured approach and a curios mindset to engineering and problem solving.
The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with others.
Professional communication skills in English.

Would you like to play a key part in the next evolution of Toca Boca’s technology platform? With over 60 million monthly active users, a massive global footprint, and peaks of about 1,400 requests per second, as a Senior Platform Engineer, you will shape the cloud infrastructure that powers our entire play ecosystem.

At Toca Boca, we don’t lock you into endless, repetitive maintenance silos. Joining our newly established Central Tech platform team, you will enjoy broad, end-to-end ownership. Your mission will be to elevate our cloud strategy, build highly scalable backend platform services, and pave the way for a modern, efficient developer experience across all our game teams.

You will partner with game developers, acting as a force multiplier so they can focus on what they do best: building the best possible games for kids and families worldwide.

What you’ll be doing

Drive the full lifecycle of Central Tech platform services—from greenfield development to optimizing high-throughput backend services handling millions of active players.
Serve as an internal platform champion. You’ll deeply understand the needs of our game teams, building the tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that make their workflows seamless and efficient.
Lead the evolution of our cloud environment, promoting best-in-class workflows using Terraform, Docker, and orchestration platforms (ECS, EKS/Kubernetes).
Define and implement robust monitoring, alerting, and logging strategies (using tools like Datadog) alongside secure AWS practices to guarantee a resilient, top-tier platform.
Act as a natural knowledge sharer. You'll coach other developers in cloud infrastructure best practices, raising the technical bar for the entire organization.

Is This You?

Strong professional experience with AWS at scale, ideally powering non-web consumers like mobile apps, APIs, and high-concurrency backend services.
Deep hands-on experience in an Infrastructure as Code (IaC) environment (Terraform, etc.) and container orchestration (Docker, ECS, Kubernetes/EKS).
Solid production-level experience with TypeScript for backend development.
A great understanding of databases, including both Relational and NoSQL database architectures (the larger the data volume, the better!).
Experience configuring and working with modern observability suites (such as Datadog).
A natural instinct for knowledge sharing, with a proven track record of coaching junior engineers and helping teams adopt new tools.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate open-ended, non-technical requirements into robust, elegant technical solutions.

This is us!

Toca Boca together with Sago Mini, Piknik and Lylli, make up Digital Games within Spin Master. We create games, digital toys, and everyday products that are filled with fun that kids from any corner of the world can instantly relate to. We celebrate the diversity and quirkiness of their world and give them the freedom to play in ways that only they can.

The Spin Master Mission and Vision is to make life more fun by pushing the boundaries of innovation, creativity, and fun!

Good to know!

This position is full time and based in our Stockholm office with a hybrid working model. We apply a 6-month probationary period. As we’re an international company, with over 20 nationalities working here, and millions of users all over the world, you must be fluent in English.

Toca Boca develops digital games that capture the power of play and that are filled with fun and silliness that kids around the world can instantly relate to. Since our first product launch in 2011, we have released 46 apps that have been downloaded more than 444 million times the world over, making us the No. 1 mobile-first kids brand in the App Store. Our products focus on sparking kids’ creativity and imagination, creating opportunities for open-ended play.

With offices in Stockholm and San Francisco, Toca Boca is owned by Spin Master Corp., a global children’s entertainment company that creates, designs and manufactures a diversified portfolio of innovative toys, games, products and entertainment properties.

Are you an empathetic leader passionate about operational excellence, people development, and tech-driven innovation? Do you want to guide an international payroll team through a transformation toward smarter, more efficient ways of working? 
About the role
As Akind grows and expands, our Payroll function is transforming into a two-pillar model to meet the future needs of the business. By separating system and process ownership from daily operations, we are establishing a clearer structure focused on strategic development, smarter systems, and reliable operational delivery. This structural change creates a vacancy in a high-impact role: Group Payroll Operations Manager.
Reporting directly to the Head of Payroll, you will lead an engaged team of nine Payroll Specialists, making remote and hybrid leadership a natural part of your daily routine. As a member of the Payroll Management Team, you will act as the vital bridge between strategy, technology, and daily operational execution.
The Payroll function manages operations across multiple markets—including Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, and Germany—delivered both in-house and through external payroll partners.
In this role, you will create the right conditions for your team to succeed by driving high-quality delivery and continuously refining our structures, processes, and cross-functional collaboration.
Work tasks
Leading, motivating, and developing the team while being responsible for resource planning.
Ensuring that payroll runs are executed with the highest quality and on time for all companies and countries.
Managing the ongoing relationship and following up on external payroll partners.
Driving internal knowledge sharing and ensuring the team is updated on laws, regulations, and collective agreements.
Acting as the main escalation point for operational problems in day-to-day work.

We are looking for
To thrive at Akind Group, you align with our core values: Show Heart, Share Energy, and Beat Yesterday.

You combine operational excellence with a strong capability to guide teams through change, creating stability during periods of development. Furthermore, you thrive in a tech-driven environment where processes and systems are constantly evolving, and you possess the stakeholder management skills necessary to navigate a complex, international organization.  
Other requirements for this role are:
About five years of leadership experience, preferably including experience leading remote teams.
Experience from Payroll, HR operations, Finance operations, or other complex, heavily regulated environments (e.g., Shared Service Centers or Customer Operations).
Strong change management skills and a good understanding of how systems and technology support operational processes.

jobs.occupation: Technical Support Engineer- EV charging & Battery Storage
jobs.description:
The role combines pre-sales technical support, solution design, customer training, commissioning, and after-sales support. You will work closely with customers, sales teams, R&D, production, installers, and other partners throughout the project lifecycle.
Key Responsibilities
· Provide pre-sales technical consultation and solution design for EV charging, BESS, and PV projects.
· Prepare technical solutions based on customer requirements and site conditions, including:
o System sizing and architecture
o Product selection and configuration
o EV charger, BESS, and PV integration
o Economic analysis to identify cost-effective system configurations
· Support the sales team with technical clarification, project discussions, and the preparation of technical proposals.
· Conduct customer training, product demonstrations, and technical presentations independently.
· Perform or support on-site commissioning, testing, troubleshooting, and configuration of EV chargers and BESS systems.
· Provide after-sales technical support, including fault analysis, troubleshooting, and coordination with customers, installers, and internal engineering teams.
· Work closely with R&D and product teams to communicate field feedback and support technical issue resolution and product improvement.
· Travel mainly within Sweden, with occasional travel to other Nordic and European markets as required for commissioning, troubleshooting, training, customer visits, and other technical support activities.
Qualifications
· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation, or another relevant technical field.
· Good understanding of industrial low-voltage (LV) electrical systems, particularly 400 V three-phase systems commonly used in commercial and industrial applications.
· Familiarity with electrical components and equipment such as power cables, circuit breakers, protection devices, energy meters, current transformers (CTs), controllers, switches, relays, and electrical distribution equipment.
· Ability to understand basic cable sizing, electrical connections, power distribution, protection concepts, and equipment interfaces.
· Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, electrical schematics, technical documentation, and system diagrams.
· Comfortable working hands-on with electrical and control equipment during testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities.
· Able to independently perform basic system checks, equipment configuration, commissioning preparation, and fault diagnosis within the scope of the role.
· Strong interest in renewable energy, energy storage, EV charging, smart energy management, and electrification technologies.
· Good communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
· Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with sales teams, engineers, customers, installers, and other partners.
· Proficiency in English is required.
Preferred Qualifications
The following qualifications are considered strong advantages:
· Previous experience in EV charging infrastructure, BESS, power systems, renewable energy, PV, EMS, or related technologies.
· Experience working with 400 V LV distribution systems, switchboards, electrical cabinets, meters, controllers, and related field equipment.
· Experience with commissioning, troubleshooting, testing, or technical support of electrical or power electronic equipment.
· Practical understanding of power cables, cable selection, CTs, energy meters, protection devices, and electrical measurement equipment.
· Experience using common electrical measurement and diagnostic tools during commissioning and troubleshooting.
· Knowledge of communication protocols and interfaces such as Modbus TCP/RTU, OCPP, Ethernet, RS485, or similar industrial communication systems.
· Basic understanding of industrial networking, IP configuration, and communication between chargers, BESS, meters, controllers, and EMS systems is an advantage.
· Swedish or European electrical qualification/certificate, or relevant practical experience in electrical installation and commissioning.
Personal Profile
We are looking for someone who is:
· Technically curious and willing to continuously learn new products and technologies.
· Genuinely interested in the rapidly developing EV charging, energy storage, and renewable energy industries.
· Customer-oriented and comfortable communicating technical topics with different stakeholders.
· Hands-on and willing to participate in field testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning.
· Structured, responsible, and capable of managing multiple technical tasks or projects in parallel.
· Flexible and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-growing technical environment.

About Froda 
Froda was founded in 2015 with a clear vision – to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs by making it easy and affordable to invest in their ideas. Today, we are one of Sweden's fastest-growing fintech companies with large international growth plans. We are a creative tech company with the ambition to turn a historically expensive and unfair industry into something ethical and sustainable by promoting entrepreneurship.
Our mission to revolutionize the banking experience for entrepreneurs is not only reflected in our products but also in our workplace. By fostering a culture of respect, collaboration, and continuous learning, we provide opportunities for personal growth and professional development. Join us in transforming the banking industry and be a part of our journey to empower entrepreneurs.
About the Role 
To further develop and scale our tech platform, enabling us to continue improving the banking experience for entrepreneurs, we are expanding our tech department. As a Backend Developer at Froda, you will be part of a cross-functional team working in one of our product areas — either developing features for our partners, improving our credit systems or maintaining our loan and payments core. For each team, the idea is to continuously deliver customer value as well as to improve the technical structure to make sure our systems are stable and healthy. Together with your team, you will design, build, and deliver scalable and maintainable solutions that directly impact our customers.
You will get a unique chance to be a part of a scaling fintech company with strong momentum and a stable foundation, backed by a banking license as a quality stamp.
Who are you?
We believe that you are an experienced and curious developer who thrives in collaborative environments and is passionate about building scalable solutions with real impact. You enjoy working closely with other skilled and open-minded professionals and actively contribute to knowledge sharing and continuous improvement. You are a pragmatic problem solver who communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You are fluent in English, Swedish is a plus.
We believe that you have experience of:

At least 4 years in a similar role, ideally within product-focused teams

Programming in C#/.NET with a solid understanding of modern software design principles

Working with SQL and NoSQL databases in production environments

Cloud platforms such as Azure (or other major providers)

Agile methodologies and best practices in software engineering, including testing, CI/CD, and DevOps mindset

Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, and microservices architecture is a strong plus

What’s in it for you? 
At Froda, you’ll be part of a company that combines the best of both worlds – a fast-moving, high-energy culture with the stability and structure to support long-term success. We’re 100+ ambitious self-starters who genuinely care for each other and the work we do, all while having fun together.
Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of your work, develop your skills, and shape your own growth journey. With big ambitions and a rapidly evolving business, there’s plenty of room to grow, lead initiatives, and make a real impact on both our company and the industry. If you're looking to be part of a success story and contribute to something bigger, this is the place for you.
Furthermore, you’ll get: 

An opportunity to be part of an exciting journey, shaping the future of our company and transforming the SME financing landscape

Fabulous office overlooking Stockholm and a friendly culture that values work/life balance

We prioritize working in the office to maximize the positive impact of in-person collaboration, but we offer flexibility with work hours and remote work

Competitive compensation package

Insurance and pension plan

This role is all about building the tech that powers funding for thousands of entrepreneurs —if you're excited by our mission, apply or tell a friend!

Job Scope
Why does the role exist? High level purpose of function.
The Manufacturing Engineer plays a key role in process equipment commissioning, production ramp-up, and full-scale manufacturing within a battery cell production facility. They ensure smooth start-up of production lines, optimize manufacturing processes, and lead continuous improvement initiatives to maximize process yield, equipment availability, and overall production performance. This role combines hands-on equipment commissioning experience, cross-functional collaboration, and technical expertise to deliver safe, efficient, and high-quality battery cell production. The manufacturing engineer is responsible for all aspects of their process machine including technical functionality, how personnel interact with it, what maintenance activities are recommended, and what crucial spares are required.  
Key Responsibilities
Overall areas of responsibilities and activities
Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to)
·      Participate in HAZOP sessions and ensure compliance with process safety, operational safety, and environmental standards. 
·      Promote a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout production and commissioning activities. 
·      Lead process equipment commissioning, including cold and hot commissioning on-site during start-up or restart projects. (Project timeline dependent) 
·      Facilitate smooth transitions from commissioning to production ramp-up and full-scale manufacturing. (Project timeline dependent) 
·      Translate lessons learned into design and process improvements for future expansions. 
·      Monitor, analyze and improve production KPIs, including yield, availability, and performance. Identifying top losses, production bottlenecks, and performance gaps to drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. 
·      Lead root cause analysis (RCA) for equipment-related losses, minor stops, and process deviations. 
·      Define, release, and maintain manufacturing process standards and operator training programs. 
·      Train and mentor new engineers, operators and other support functions. 
·      Prepare, review, and approve documentation including (but not limited to); WI, PFMEAs, commissioning checklists, project timelines, A3s.  
·      Provide technical feedback and guidance to suppliers to ensure equipment quality, compliance with specifications, and CE standards. 
·      Develop and issue DOEs (Design of Experiments) and schedule process and equipment trials onsite and at supplier sites (if required). 
·      Deliver a line capable of obtaining PPAP approval, following a structured quality gate model. 
·      Complete supplementary tasks as seen fit by management to effectively utilize time and resources for the benefit of the business. 
·      This role requires regular presence on the production floor.
 
Requirements
Educational background and previous experience required for the role
Qualifications and Experience
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in mechanical, electrical, or chemical engineering. 
Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience in production, equipment, or engineering-related roles. 
Proven track record of leading manufacturing process improvements and production optimization in a factory environment following recognised project management techniques.  
Experience in building and scaling production in a fast-growing environment, ideally within the battery, food, pharma, paper & pulp, semiconductor, electrochemical, or similar industries. 
Hands-on experience and interest in equipment commissioning, troubleshooting, and optimisation. 
Proficient in detailed root cause analysis, structured problem-solving methodologies and continuous improvement. 
Familiarity with quality assurance troubleshooting tools. 
Experience working to industry standards obtaining certification including ISO, IATF &VDA .
Experience with statistical process control and process capability analysis. 

 
Specific skills & Knowledge 
Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems. 
Knowledge of lean manufacturing principles and six sigma methodologies .
Knowledge of OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metrics and their application in production environments. 

·       Strong technical curiosity, analytical mindset, and business-oriented problem-solving skills. 
·       Troubleshooting skills with diagnostic equipment. 
Ability to document technical problems concisely. 
Excellent English skills, both written and oral, are essential. Basic Swedish and other language skills are a plus. You should have good communication skills and be able to work in close collaboration with colleagues from many different teams. 
Ability to work within varying environments including clean-rooms and dry-rooms, while wearing appropriate PPE. 
Comfortable operating in high-profile, international, and high-pressure environments. 
A genuine technical interest and passion about working within production is highly valued.
